ocr.notes: Arresting detectives are 'Burke and Fitzgerald' in the image, not 'Hogan and Fitzgerald'; image spells 'McMannus' once.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that St. Louis County issued prize-fighting warrants over the Kelly-McManus fight at Florissant, and that Tom Allen and others were arrested and gave $500 bond each.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Monday, February 11, 1889, page 2.

facts.fact: A St. Louis County warrant for prize-fighting was issued against Allen and others as seconds and aiders in the Ed Kelly-Hugh McManus fight at Florissant
Allen was arrested in St. Louis and released on $500 bond for his part in the Florissant prize fight
